description: This file contains unit tests for the RootCanvas component, specifically testing the conditions under which the quick setup presentation logic is triggered in the context of gateway configuration scenarios.

classes.name: RootCanvasPresentationTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases for RootCanvas's quick setup presentation logic.

methods.name: quickSetupDoesNotPresentWhenGatewayAlreadyConfigured
methods.description: Test to verify quick setup is not presented when a gateway is already configured and the sheet has not been dismissed.

methods.name: quickSetupPresentsForFreshInstallWithDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Test to ensure quick setup is prompted during a fresh install when a gateway has been discovered.

methods.name: quickSetupDoesNotPresentWhenAlreadyConnected
methods.description: Test to confirm quick setup is not presented when already connected to a gateway.
